contracts.protection_obligation: Engines built by EngineManager for a datasource must enforce the datasource read-only and timeout policy at the connection layer: SQLite read_only datasources get PRAGMA query_only = ON on every new connection; Postgres datasources get SET default_transaction_read_only = on when read_only and SET statement_timeout on every connection; MSSQL read_only datasources get ApplicationIntent=ReadOnly forced into the connection string — serving as defense-in-depth beneath the statement-level guard so write/DDL effects and unbounded queries cannot commit even if a statement guard is bypassed.
